about.title: About Crowi
about.description: Crowi is an open-source Markdown-based wiki application. Originally released in 2014, it's built so teams can share what they know.
about.lede: Write in Markdown, connect with links, retrieve through search — a wiki built for the long haul.

items.title: Brand-new frontend
items.description: Express + Swig + jQuery is out. Next.js (App Router) + React + Tailwind is in — built for the modern web.

items.title: API-first
items.description: Server and view fully separated. A type-safe API contract makes Crowi programmable from anywhere.

items.title: Compatible with v1 data
items.description: A clean migration path keeps everything your team has already written. No knowledge left behind.

items.title: Modern runtime
items.description: Node.js 24.x, MongoDB, Redis, optional Elasticsearch — plus pluggable storage, search, and auth.

status.title: Where we are
status.description: Active development on main. Core features, realtime collab, editor UX, and the admin section have all migrated to the new stack (Hono + Next.js 16). What's left is pluggable auth providers, Slack integration, the external Share link, and the v2.0 stable release.
newFeatures: MCP server (read/write the wiki from AI)

footer.copyright: Crowi is open source software released under the MIT License.
footer.tagline: Empower the team with sharing your knowledge.
